cards.front: You want to say none are left out: “The students all came.” 学生___来了。
cards.back: 学生全都来了。全都 stresses “all, without exception”; 都 alone can be lighter.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 全都 when every member is included without exception.
cards.reason: Stable production cue for the emphatic all-without-exception use; scaffolding uses only basic words plus the target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous, not multiple-valid because the cue asks for emphatic no-exception scope; not narrow, shallow, wordy, or redundant.

gloss: link; stage; part of a process

cards.front: A plan has several connected stages; one stage has a problem. Which word names that process link/stage?
cards.back: 环节。这个环节有问题 = this stage/link has a problem. It treats the part as one link in a whole process.
cards.retrievalTarget: Choose 环节 for a linked stage or component within a larger process.
cards.reason: Targets the figurative process-stage sense instead of generic part; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front does not contain the answer; single stable answer; useful process-collocation boundary.

cards.front: For a restaurant as a business/place, which classifiers fit: 一___餐厅 / 一___餐厅?
cards.back: 一家餐厅 / 一间餐厅。家 fits a restaurant business; 间 fits a room/place.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 餐厅 for restaurant/dining room and pair it with 家 or 间 by sense.
cards.reason: Classifier choice supports production and disambiguates business vs room; scaffolding is minimal and basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: multiple classifiers are expected and named in the prompt; not ambiguous because retrieval target includes both.

gloss: to violate; go against a rule/law

cards.front: Someone acts against a rule or law, not just disagrees with a person. Which verb fits?
cards.back: 违反。违反规定 = violate rules [规定 = rule/regulation]; 违反法律 = violate the law [法律 = law].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 违反 for violating or going against rules, laws, or requirements.
cards.reason: Precise legal/rule-bound use; the only support terms beyond the target are glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 反对 because the cue specifies rule/law violation; front does not imply pronunciation or characters.

cards.front: A city, person, or class feels energetic and alive: 很有___。
cards.back: 很有活力 = full of energy/vitality. 活力 is lively force, not physical strength 力气.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 活力 for vitality or lively energy in people, groups, and places.
cards.reason: Contrasts vitality with mere physical strength; Chinese scaffold uses target plus basic pattern.
cards.notes: Self-audit: answer not visible in front; cue is broad enough for productive use but points to one noun.

gloss: to entrust; commission someone to do something

cards.front: You formally ask another person/company to handle a task for you. Which verb fits “___他办这件事”?
cards.back: 委托他办这件事 = entrust/commission him to handle this matter. It is more formal than 请他帮忙.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 委托 + person/organization + task for formally entrusting or commissioning work.
cards.reason: Captures formality and argument pattern; Chinese support is basic plus the target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 请 because formal entrusting is specified; stable collocation frame.

cards.front: A bed is comfortable because it is not hard; a person’s attitude can also become less firm. Which adjective?
cards.back: 软。床很软 = the bed is soft. 态度软下来 = the attitude softened [态度 = attitude].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 软 for physical softness and extended lack of firmness/flexibility.
cards.reason: Links physical and figurative senses; one non-basic support word is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single adjective target; no answer leakage; not shallow because it includes figurative extension.

cards.front: On a form, you write your name by hand. What word names the action/result? 请在这里___。
cards.back: 请在这里签名 = please sign here. 签名 can be the action “sign” or the noun “signature.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 签名 for signing one’s name and for the resulting signature.
cards.reason: Production cue covers noun/verb ambiguity; Chinese is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 写名字 because the form/register cue asks for sign/signature.

cards.front: Not just taking one casual photo: the art/work of taking photos or shooting film. Which word?
cards.back: 摄影。摄影师 = photographer [师 = professional/person]; 摄影 can also mean filming a movie.
cards.retrievalTarget: Choose 摄影 for photography or filming as an activity/profession, beyond one casual photo.
cards.reason: Separates activity/profession from 拍照片; one support morpheme is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front asks for register/activity distinction; no trivial answer clue.

cards.front: Formal written style: a tool is used for study, work, or medicine. Which two-character verb before the purpose?
cards.back: 用于。这个方法用于学习 = this method is used for study. It is more written/formal than 用来.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 用于 as formal “be used for/in/on” before a purpose or field.
cards.reason: Worth retaining despite function-like status because it distinguishes written register from 用来.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not redundant with 用来 card because this one targets formal 用于 register.

cards.front: A headline or formal notice says “today,” not everyday 今天. Which written word?
cards.back: 今日。今日天气 = today’s weather. It is written/formal compared with 今天.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 今日 as a written or headline-style equivalent of 今天.
cards.reason: Register distinction supports reading; scaffold uses basic 今天/天气 contrast.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single register target; no answer in front; not too narrow because headlines/notices are common.

cards.front: A fan says a singer or actor is the person they admire most: 他是我的___。
cards.back: 他是我的偶像 = he is my idol. 偶像 is used for admired public figures and fan culture.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 偶像 for an idol or admired public figure, especially in fan contexts.
cards.reason: Production cue anchors the fan/public-figure sense; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 喜欢的人 because “idol” and fan culture are specified.

gloss: session; edition; classifier for recurring events/classes

cards.front: For the 10th meeting/competition as one edition in a series: 第十___。Which classifier?
cards.back: 第十届 = the 10th session/edition. 届 counts recurring events, conferences, competitions, or graduating classes.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 届 as the classifier for numbered sessions/editions of recurring events or classes.
cards.reason: Although measure-like, it is not trivial; the recurring-event constraint is production-critical.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front allows only the series-edition classifier; not redundant with general 个/次.

cards.front: Something is in the way, blocking your view: 别___着我。
cards.back: 别挡着我 = don’t block me / don’t get in my way. 挡 can block people, sight, wind, or light.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 挡 for physically or functionally blocking/obstructing something.
cards.reason: Concrete production phrase extends to common objects; Chinese is target plus basic words.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 停 because the clue says blocking/in the way; front does not give answer.

cards.front: You see a face and know who it is; later you admit a mistake. What shared verb appears in both?
cards.back: 认。认出他 = recognize him; 认错 = admit a mistake / recognize wrongly. It can mean recognize or acknowledge/admit.
cards.retrievalTarget: Connect 认’s recognize sense with admitting or acknowledging something as true.
cards.reason: Builds a stable semantic bridge across common compounds; support examples are basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not shallow because it prevents treating 认 as only “recognize”; answer not cued by characters.

cards.front: Before deciding whether food is good, take a taste: 你___一下。
cards.back: 你尝一下 = have a taste. 尝 is for tasting/trying food; it can extend to experiencing something.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 尝 for tasting or trying food, with extension to experiencing.
cards.reason: Simple but production-useful food verb; Chinese scaffold is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 试 because “taste food” specifies 尝; not wordy.

cards.front: Medicine enters the body through a needle, not by eating or drinking. Which medical verb/noun?
cards.back: 注射。注射药 = inject medicine [药 = medicine]. 注射 can name the action or an injection.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 注射 for injecting medicine/liquid with a needle and for an injection.
cards.reason: Concrete medical action with noun/verb ambiguity; one support noun is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single answer; front avoids the Chinese target; not narrow because injections recur in reading.

cards.front: Two plans, interests, or groups clash so both cannot smoothly coexist. Which noun/verb?
cards.back: 冲突。时间冲突 = schedule conflict; 利益冲突 = conflict of interest [利益 = interest/benefit].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 冲突 for clashes between times, interests, ideas, or groups.
cards.reason: Targets abstract clash/collision, not generic problem; one higher collocate is glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable target; not ambiguous with 问题 because clash/incompatibility is specified.

gloss: to be present; on the scene

cards.front: At the meeting/accident scene, someone was there in person. Which word says “present on site”?
cards.back: 在场。他当时在场 = he was present there at the time. 不在场 = not present / not on the scene.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 在场 for being physically present at an event or scene.
cards.reason: Distinguishes on-site presence from generic 在; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 在 because “at event/scene in person” requires 在场.

cards.front: A topic causes strong reactions; skin reacts easily; a person is easily hurt. Which adjective covers this sensitivity?
cards.back: 敏感。敏感问题 = sensitive issue; 皮肤敏感 = sensitive skin [皮肤 = skin].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 敏感 for emotional, political/topic, or physical sensitivity.
cards.reason: Unifies common abstract and physical uses; one non-basic support word is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: broad but not shallow because it gives domains; front does not include Chinese answer.

cards.front: Which bound animal character appears in 老鼠 and 鼠标?
cards.back: 鼠。老鼠 = rat/mouse; 鼠标 = computer mouse [标 = marker]. 鼠 is usually bound, not a common standalone spoken noun.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 鼠 as the rat/mouse morpheme in compounds such as 老鼠 and 鼠标.
cards.reason: Bound-form behavior and compound recognition matter for reading; one support morpheme is glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not redundant with 老鼠 because target is the bound morpheme 鼠; front asks for character-level retrieval.

cards.front: A screen gives a hint/reminder about what to do next. Which word names the prompt or hint?
cards.back: 提示。系统提示 = system prompt/notice [系统 = system]. 提示 can be a hint, reminder, or the act of prompting.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 提示 for a hint, reminder, notice, or prompt that points someone toward action.
cards.reason: Targets common UI/reading sense; one support word is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single functional cue; no answer leakage; not narrow because UI prompts and reminders are common.

gloss: to fall; throw down; drop and break

cards.front: A person falls, or a phone drops hard and breaks. Which verb? 他___倒了。
cards.back: 他摔倒了 = he fell down. 手机摔坏了 = the phone was damaged from a fall/drop.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 摔 for falling, throwing down, or dropping something hard enough to damage it.
cards.reason: Covers the fall/drop-damage cluster; Chinese support uses common words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 掉 because damage/hard fall is specified; front does not trivially imply answer.

cards.front: Two people exchange ideas to understand each other, not just say words. Which verb?
cards.back: 沟通。我们需要沟通 = we need to communicate. It stresses two-way understanding/connection.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 沟通 for two-way communication that connects people or ideas.
cards.reason: Separates interactive communication from generic 说; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable near-synonym split; not multiple-valid because two-way understanding is the cue.

gloss: to tidy up; pack; sort out

cards.front: Before leaving, put your things in order and pack them: ___东西。
cards.back: 收拾东西 = tidy/pack things. 收拾房间 = clean up a room; colloquially it can also mean “deal with/fix” someone.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 收拾 for tidying, putting in order, or packing things up.
cards.reason: High-value household/travel collocation; colloquial extension is noted without requiring extra unknowns.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front cues the core sense; not too broad because back handles extension.

cards.front: Only one condition changes the result: “___你去，我才去。”
cards.back: 除非你去，我才去 = I’ll go only if you go. 除非 sets the necessary exception/condition.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 除非 to introduce the only condition or exception: unless/only if.
cards.reason: Production cue for a difficult connector; Chinese scaffold is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable connector retrieval; not multiple-valid because the paired 才 structure cues only-if.

cards.front: On a bus, train, or plane, the people riding are not drivers or staff. Which noun?
cards.back: 乘客。车上的乘客 = passengers on the vehicle. 乘客 is the rider/passenger role.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 乘客 for passengers riding in public or private transport.
cards.reason: Role contrast is production-relevant; scaffolding uses only basic transport/person words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single noun target; answer not present; not overly narrow because transport contexts are frequent.

cards.front: A road, choice, or period is not just hard; it feels arduous and full of difficulty. Which formal adjective?
cards.back: 艰难。艰难的决定 = difficult/arduous decision [决定 = decision]. It is heavier and more written than 难.
cards.retrievalTarget: Choose 艰难 for arduous, serious difficulty, often in written or weighty contexts.
cards.reason: Register/intensity contrast with 难; one collocate is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 困难 because cue asks for heavier/written adjective; no answer leakage.

cards.front: Everyday pattern for purpose: “This cup is used for drinking water.” 这个杯子是___喝水的。
cards.back: 这个杯子是用来喝水的。用来 + verb says what something is used to do; 用于 is more written/formal.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 用来 + verb for the everyday purpose/function of a thing.
cards.reason: Contrasts with 用于 while teaching productive purpose pattern; Chinese is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not redundant with 用于 because retrieval target is everyday 用来 + verb syntax.

cards.front: A singer releases a group of songs together, not just one song. Which noun?
cards.back: 专辑。新专辑 = new album. It can also mean a special collected issue/program, but music album is common.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 专辑 for an album or curated special collection, especially a music album.
cards.reason: Distinguishes album/collection from single song; Chinese support is target plus basic modifier.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable target; no unsupported Chinese unknowns; not shallow because collection sense is noted.

cards.front: Which animal word takes 只 and means tiger: 一___?
cards.back: 一只虎 / 一只老虎 = one tiger. 虎 is often the shorter/written morpheme; 老虎 is the common spoken word.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 虎 as the tiger morpheme, often shorter or more written than 老虎.
cards.reason: Not just animal naming: targets bound/short-form contrast with 老虎; scaffold is basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front asks for tiger word but not characters; productive classifier included.

gloss: to go around; wind around; bypass; confuse

cards.front: The road is blocked, so you go around it instead of through it. Which verb?
cards.back: 绕。绕过去 = go around/bypass it. 绕 can also mean wind around, as a rope around a hand.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 绕 for going around, winding around, or bypassing an obstacle.
cards.reason: Concrete spatial image supports the extended bypass sense; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 走 because “around instead of through” specifies 绕.

cards.front: Water, smoke, or air suddenly shoots out from a small opening. Which pēn verb?
cards.back: 喷 (pēn)。喷水 = spray water; 喷出来 = spurt/spray out. This is the action reading, not pèn for strong smell/season.
cards.retrievalTarget: Read 喷 as pēn for spraying, spurting, or spouting outward.
cards.reason: Pronunciation/use contrast with pèn; examples use basic words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: front includes pinyin to disambiguate duplicate entry; retrieval target is pronunciation plus sense.

cards.front: Same character as “spray,” but this pèn reading describes a strong smell, as in 香喷喷. Which reading/sense?
cards.back: 喷 (pèn)。香喷喷 = strongly fragrant [香 = fragrant]. Do not read this as pēn “spray.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Read 喷 as pèn in smell-intensity words such as 香喷喷, distinct from pēn “spray.”
cards.reason: Keeps the rare pronunciation from collapsing into pēn; the one support word is glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: duplicate character is intentionally disambiguated by pinyin; not multiple-valid.

cards.front: Someone keeps saying they are unhappy about work or life, not just giving feedback. Which verb?
cards.back: 抱怨。他总是抱怨工作 = he always complains about work. It carries dissatisfaction/grumbling.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 抱怨 for complaining or grumbling from dissatisfaction.
cards.reason: Distinguishes complaint/grumbling from neutral comments; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable affective cue; not ambiguous with 说 because dissatisfaction is explicit.

cards.front: A man-made object goes around Earth in space. Which noun, and which classifier: 一___卫星?
cards.back: 一颗卫星 = one satellite. 卫星 can be artificial satellite or a natural moon; 颗 often counts small round/sky objects.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 卫星 for satellite/moon and pair it with classifier 颗.
cards.reason: Combines meaning and classifier; Chinese support is target plus basic classifier pattern.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous because satellite/moon domain is specified; classifier retrieval is explicit.

gloss: to start doing; to hit/use violence

cards.front: “Start working on it” and “hit someone” can both be this word. What warning must you remember?
cards.back: 动手 can mean start doing a task: 开始动手吧. It can also mean use hands violently: 他动手打人 = he hit someone.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish 动手 as “start doing hands-on work” from “use violence/hit.”
cards.reason: Prevents a high-risk sense error; Chinese examples use basic words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: two senses are intentionally contrasted; front asks for the distinction, not a vague meaning.

cards.front: You move closer to the door/person, or are located near them: 不要___门。
cards.back: 不要靠近门 = don’t go near/approach the door. 靠近 can describe movement toward or being near.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 靠近 for approaching or being close to a person/place/object.
cards.reason: Covers dynamic and static near senses; Chinese scaffold is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 近 because verb approach is cued; stable production frame.

cards.front: The person living next door is your ___: 他是我的___。
cards.back: 他是我的邻居 = he is my neighbor. 邻居 is the person/household nearby, not just “near.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 邻居 for a neighbor or next-door household/person.
cards.reason: Simple production noun with no extra unknown burden; distinguishes person from location adjective.
cards.notes: Self-audit: answer not in front; cue is direct but not trivial for production.

cards.front: Air or water becomes dirty/harmful because of human activity. Which verb/noun?
cards.back: 污染。空气污染 = air pollution; 污染水 = pollute water. It can also extend to moral/media contamination in formal writing.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 污染 for polluting or contamination of air, water, environments, or figurative domains.
cards.reason: Targets environmental core with figurative extension; Chinese examples are basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single clear answer; not overly narrow because both verb and noun behavior are included.

cards.front: A rule was broken, so the teacher/police makes the person pay or suffer a penalty: ___钱 / ___他。
cards.back: 罚钱 = fine someone money; 罚他 = punish him. 罚 is penalty/punishment after wrongdoing.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 罚 for punishing or fining someone for breaking a rule.
cards.reason: Shows productive object patterns and rule-breaking context; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 骂 because penalty after rule-breaking is specified.

cards.front: You are waiting for the right moment to act, not just any time on the clock. Which noun?
cards.back: 时机。好时机 = good opportunity/right moment. 时间 is time in general; 时机 is timing/opportune moment.
cards.retrievalTarget: Choose 时机 for the opportune moment or timing to act.
cards.reason: Useful distinction from 时间; Chinese support uses basic contrast words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable near-synonym split; not multiple-valid because “right moment to act” cues 时机.

cards.front: A neighborhood is safe because crime is low and public order is good. Which formal noun?
cards.back: 治安。这里治安很好 = public security/law and order is good here. It is about social order and safety.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 治安 for public security or law-and-order conditions in a place.
cards.reason: Formal civic-domain noun; Chinese scaffold is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 安全 because cue says public order/crime conditions; no answer leakage.

cards.front: Bad news arrives and you react: “Oh no, this is terrible.” ___！
cards.back: 糟糕！= Oh no!/Terrible! 事情很糟糕 = the situation is bad/awful.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 糟糕 as an exclamation or adjective for an awful/bad situation.
cards.reason: Captures both interjection and adjective use; no extra Chinese unknowns beyond basic support.
cards.notes: Self-audit: exclamation cue makes target stable; front avoids Chinese answer.

gloss: in the air; in the sky

cards.front: A plane, bird, or object is not on the ground; it is in the air/sky. Which location word?
cards.back: 空中。飞机在空中 = the plane is in the air. 空中 is a location/medium, more written than 天上 in some contexts.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 空中 for being in the air or sky, especially in written descriptions.
cards.reason: Location/register cue for reading; Chinese support is target plus basic words.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 天上 because written/in-air medium is specified.

cards.front: Someone wants freedom or success very deeply, stronger and more written than 想要. Which verb/noun?
cards.back: 渴望。渴望自由 = long for freedom [自由 = freedom]. It is a deep, often emotional desire.
cards.retrievalTarget: Choose 渴望 for deep longing or yearning, stronger than ordinary wanting.
cards.reason: Intensity/register contrast with 想要; one collocate is glossed inline.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable target because “deep longing” rules out simple 想; front does not contain answer.

cards.front: Two computers, roads, or ideas are linked together. Which verb? A和B___起来。
cards.back: A和B连接起来 = connect/link A and B together. 连接 often joins two parts into a system.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 连接 for linking or connecting two parts, devices, roads, or ideas.
cards.reason: Productive A-and-B connection pattern; Chinese scaffold is minimal and basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid with 联系 because physical/system link is cued; no answer leakage.

gloss: to take apart; dismantle; tear open

cards.front: You open a package by tearing it, or take a machine/house apart. Which verb?
cards.back: 拆。拆包 = open/tear open a package [包 = package/bag]; 拆房子 = tear down a house.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 拆 for opening by taking apart/tearing open or dismantling something.
cards.reason: Unifies package-opening and dismantling senses; support word 包 is basic/glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable action image; not ambiguous with 开 because taking apart/tearing is specified.

cards.front: In written narration, “at this moment” points to the current moment in the story. Which word?
cards.back: 此时。此时，他走了进来 = at this moment, he walked in. It is more written than 这时候.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 此时 as written “at this moment/now” in narration or formal text.
cards.reason: Register cue for reading; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not redundant with 现在 because written narrative moment is specified.

cards.front: Which animal word takes 条 as classifier: 一___蛇?
cards.back: 一条蛇 = one snake. 条 fits long, thin things and animals like fish/snakes.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 蛇 for snake and pair it with classifier 条.
cards.reason: Classifier production card with no extra unknown burden.
cards.notes: Self-audit: direct but useful; not multiple-valid because classifier and animal are specified.

cards.front: For body parts on the side of the head: 一___耳朵 / 一___耳朵 / 一___耳朵. Which classifiers are possible?
cards.back: 一只耳朵, 一个耳朵, 一对耳朵. 只 is common for one ear; 对 means a pair.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 耳朵 for ear and recall common classifiers 只, 个, and 对.
cards.reason: Classifier variation is production-relevant; Chinese scaffold is basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: multiple answers are intentionally requested; no ambiguity outside the listed classifier set.

cards.front: In a film, photo, or memory, you refer to the visible scene/image, not the story itself. Which noun?
cards.back: 画面。这个画面很美 = this image/scene is beautiful. It can be a screen image, film frame, or mental picture.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 画面 for the visible image/scene/frame on screen, in film, or in memory.
cards.reason: Disambiguates visual scene/image from generic picture/story; Chinese support is basic plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable target; broad domains are unified by visible-image sense.

cards.front: On a menu, water, juice, tea, or soda are grouped as what noun?
cards.back: 饮料。买饮料 = buy drinks/beverages. It is a category noun, not the verb “to drink.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 饮料 for drinks/beverages as a category noun.
cards.reason: Simple category production distinction from 喝; scaffold uses basic words only.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not ambiguous with 水 because category grouping is specified; answer not in front.

gloss: to play the role of; act as

cards.front: An actor plays a character; in society, a person plays a role. Which verb fits “___重要角色”?
cards.back: 扮演重要角色 = play an important role [角色 = role/character]. 扮演 works for acting and abstract roles.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 扮演 for playing a character or playing an abstract role.
cards.reason: High-value collocation and literal-to-abstract extension; one support word is glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable role-playing cue; not multiple-valid with 演 because abstract role collocation is specified.

cards.front: The organ used for thinking and memory, not just the head as an outside body part. Which noun?
cards.back: 大脑。大脑在工作 = the brain is working. 脑子 is more everyday; 大脑 is more anatomical/formal.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 大脑 for the brain as an organ/system, often more formal than 脑子.
cards.reason: Distinguishes organ/formal register from head or colloquial mind; Chinese scaffold is basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: single noun target; not redundant with 头 because internal organ is specified.

cards.front: For the body part used to smell: 一___鼻子 / 一___鼻子. Which classifiers are common?
cards.back: 一个鼻子 / 一只鼻子. 个 is common; 只 can count some body parts.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 鼻子 for nose and recall common classifiers 个 and 只.
cards.reason: Classifier support for a concrete noun; no extra unknown vocabulary.
cards.notes: Self-audit: direct production target; multiple answers are explicitly requested.

cards.front: In finance, money, houses, and other valuable things owned by a person/company are called what?
cards.back: 资产。公司资产 = company assets. 资产 is owned value/property, not monthly income.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 资产 for assets or property owned by a person, company, or organization.
cards.reason: Finance-domain distinction from income/cash; Chinese support uses basic words plus target.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable domain cue; not ambiguous with 钱 because owned valuable property is specified.

cards.front: Someone passed an exam or got a new job; you formally say congratulations: ___你！
cards.back: 祝贺你！= Congratulations! 祝贺 is more formal than 恭喜, and can be a verb or noun.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 祝贺 to congratulate someone, especially in a formal or written tone.
cards.reason: Register contrast with 恭喜 supports production; Chinese scaffold is target plus basic pronoun.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not multiple-valid because formal tone is specified; front does not expose answer.

cards.front: A wedding, war, or life-changing decision is not a small matter. Which noun?
cards.back: 大事。这是大事 = this is a major matter/event. 一件大事 = one major event/matter.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 大事 for a major event or important matter, often with classifier 件.
cards.reason: Meaning is compositional but production/register and classifier are useful; Chinese support is basic.
cards.notes: Self-audit: not too shallow because it targets “major event/matter,” not simply big+thing.

cards.front: A machine, train service, app, or system is functioning/running, not a person running on foot. Which verb?
cards.back: 运行。系统正常运行 = the system runs/operates normally [系统 = system]. 火车运行 = trains operate/run.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 运行 for systems, machines, software, routes, or services operating/running.
cards.reason: Prevents literal 跑/走 confusion and covers technical/service domains; one support term is glossed.
cards.notes: Self-audit: stable non-human running target; not multiple-valid because operation/functioning is specified.
